title: Client Biome Precipitation
description: Describes the visuals for a biome's precipitation. Biomes without this component will have default values. At most one precipitation type can be set for a biome.

red_spores.title: Red Spores
red_spores.description: Density of red spore precipitation visuals. Used in the crimson forest biome.

blue_spores.title: Blue Spores
blue_spores.description: Density of blue spore precipitation visuals. Used in the warped forest biome.

ash.title: Ash
ash.description: Density of ash precipitation visuals. Used in the soul sand valley biome.

white_ash.title: White Ash
white_ash.description: Density of white ash precipitation visuals. Used in the basalt deltas biome.
